changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE security_repositories ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, repo_slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, branch TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'main', verification_command TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(verification_command)) > 0), created_by TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ); CREATE TABLE security_incidents ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, advisory_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, title TEXT NOT NULL, severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('high', 'critical')), known_exploited BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, source_url TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT NOT NULL, importance TEXT NOT NULL, upstream_repositories JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', source_data JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ); CREATE TABLE security_assessments ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES security_incidents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, repository_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES security_repositories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK (status IN ( 'queued', 'analyzing', 'not_affected', 'awaiting_upstream', 'fix_available', 'remediating', 'action_required', 'pr_open', 'awaiting_deployment', 'resolved', 'failed')), session_id BIGINT REFERENCES agent_sessions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, report JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', pr_url TEXT, error TEXT, next_check_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE (incident_id, repository_id) ); CREATE INDEX idx_security_assessments_due ON security_assessments(next_check_at); CREATE TABLE security_assessment_events ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, assessment_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES security_assessments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, status TEXT NOT NULL, detail JSONB NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ); CREATE TABLE security_scan_observations ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES security_incidents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, repository_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES security_repositories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, image_digest TEXT NOT NULL, scanned_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, findings JSONB NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE (incident_id, repository_id, image_digest) ); CREATE TABLE security_feed_state ( name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, last_success TIMESTAMPTZ, error TEXT );
